dedupe_keys.name: alberta farm operating expenses and depreciation

description: This collection reports agricultural operating expenses including electricity, heating fuel and repairs, together with depreciation of buildings and machinery. It also contains taxes, wages, interest, insurance and biological-input costs. XLSX descriptors cover 1985–2014 and 1986–2015. The concrete infrastructure subject is the operating cost of energy services and depreciation of physical farm buildings and machinery. It does not establish physical energy quantities or asset-level condition. The overlapping releases remain one statistical collection. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source title, description and original Alberta identifiers. The record labels the material Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, current file access and numerical contents are unverified. No linked document, workbook, archive, installer or data body was fetched. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless described above.
